children: In the ongoing Phase 1/1b study, all 15 evaluable participants had reduced target cNF surface area at best response, with a median best reduction of 41%. All 18 evaluable participants showed reduced PN volume; two met the partial-response threshold.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
Median best cNF area reduction: 41%
The clinical signal may support development, but it comes from 15 evaluable participants in an ongoing early-stage trial.
At 4–12mg, median best cNF reduction: 46%
These are the doses planned for Phase 2; the subgroup included eight evaluable participants.
At Cycle 12, median cNF reduction: 49%
The reported reduction deepened with treatment duration; this is a follow-up subset, not a controlled comparison.
Two participants met PN partial-response threshold
This is an early activity signal; one response was pending confirmation on a subsequent scan.
FDA cleared IND for randomized Phase 2 cNF trial
Regulatory clearance enables the next study stage; the planned trial will evaluate three doses in approximately 200 adults.
No treatment-related serious adverse events reported
Early tolerability may support continued dosing, but the sample is small and follow-up remains ongoing.
Context by AI Analyst

This is an early clinical-stage signal from an ongoing Phase 1/1b program, not confirmatory evidence of efficacy. A larger catalyst would require the planned randomized, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial to enroll and report results, alongside confirmation of response and safety with longer follow-up.

All participants showed cutaneous neurofibroma (cNF) reductions:
All 15 evaluable participants had reductions in target cNF surface area, with a median best reduction of 41% across all doses and 46% at doses planned for Phase 2
cNF reductions deepened with continued treatment
: The median reduction in target cNF surface area reached 49% at Cycle 12 among participants followed through 12 cycles and 71% at Cycle 15 in the 4mg cohort
Favorable safety and tolerability profile:
No treatment related serious adverse events, treatment related discontinuations, retinopathy or adverse event of decreased left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF)
IND cleared for Phase 2 in cNF:
The FDA's Division of Dermatology and Dentistry has cleared the IND for a Phase 2 trial of PAS-004 in adults with NF1-associated cNF
Early activity in plexiform neurofibromas (PN
): Reductions in target PN volume observed in all 18 evaluable participants, including two with reductions ≥20%, one achieving a 22.5% reduction at the first on-treatment MRI (Cycle 4)
PAS-004 Clinical Data Webcast:
Pasithea will post a webcast on Friday, November 13, 2026, at 7:00 a.m. EST to discuss the data presented at the European Neurofibromatosis Conference
